windows.why: Owners report it works on Windows 11, but Brother's own pages describe Wi-Fi disconnects for this model, and the bundled setup software and Windows 11 USB install step draw repeated complaints; Brother gives fixes for most of them.
windows.driver: Brother's Full Driver & Software Package, which Brother's Windows Wi-Fi FAQ tells users to reinstall; Brother's EU downloads page for the HL-L2400DW lists Windows 11 and 10 software (EasySetup, iPrint&Scan, Uninstall Tool). Whether Windows Update installs a built-in driver was not verified.
problems: Wi-Fi drops, machine leaves the network (fixed by Recover WLAN on the panel, the Network Connection Repair Tool, or a firmware update, per Brother)
Printer shows Offline in Windows (Brother: Offline means the driver is not working; fixed by selecting a working driver or reinstalling the Full Driver package)
Windows 11 USB install blocked by 'Default install printers using Windows Ready Print' (fixed by turning that option off, per Brother FAQ)
Bundled EasySetup software described as buggy under Windows 11 (owner review; no fix found in the software itself, the full package from Brother's site is the workaround reported)
Wi-Fi setup must be repeated on each device (owner review; no fix found)
Wi-Fi network or router change needs driver uninstall and Wi-Fi setup again (fixed by Brother's uninstall and reconfigure steps)

sources.what: Brother Online User's Guide, page for HL-L2400DW among other models: 'My Machine Cannot Print over the Network'. Cause is the machine disconnecting from the wireless network; action is Recover WLAN. Windows IP/subnet check with the Network Connection Repair Tool; last step is to uninstall and reinstall the driver.

Brother FAQ for HL-L2400DW (Windows) 'I cannot print on a wireless (Wi-Fi) network'. Steps: remove and re-add duplicate printer icons, check status (Offline means the driver is not working), reinstall the Full Driver & Software Package, update machine and router firmware.

Brother FAQ dated 17/06/2026 for the HL-L2400DWE page (same machine body; HL-L2400DW listed in related models): on Windows 11 with USB, disable 'Default install printers using Windows Ready Print' before installing the driver.

Brother Downloads for HL-L2400DW (EU). Windows packages listed for Win11 / Win10: iPrint&Scan (06/11/2026), EasySetup (30/10/2026), Uninstall Tool and Mass Deployment Tool. Full Software Package is listed under macOS on this page.

Reviews for the HL-L2400DWE (same body, Wi-Fi model). Owners: 'Under Win 11, the easysetup software must be buggy'; Wi-Fi setup must be repeated per device; USB cable useful for setup; drivers available on Brother's site; works with Windows 11 (review by LDLCLB).

sources.what: Best Buy product page for HL-L2460DW (US sibling): rating 4.4 out of 5 from 354 reviews. Review text on the reviews page did not render.

Walmart reviews for HL-L2460DW (US sibling): 4.2 out of 5 from 599 ratings. Pros: print quality, simple wireless setup. Neutral: network connection occasionally drops; ink use. Reviews mention difficult first setup and slow wake from sleep.

LDLC reviews of HL-L2400DWE (same body): global 10/10 from 16 reviews. Praise for duplex, speed, quality, value, Windows 11. Complaints: Wi-Fi setup per device, buggy easy-setup software on Windows 11, no duplex on Ubuntu, bulky, weak documentation.
